<?php
class ScopeBase239 { public function capture($value) { echo self::class,"/",static::class,";"; return $value; } }
class Scope239 extends ScopeBase239 { public static function launch() { global $owner; $owner->MiSsInG((\Closure::fromCallable([new self,"capture"]))(true)); $owner->MiSsInG((\Closure::fromCallable([new parent,"capture"]))(true)); $owner->MiSsInG(first:(\Closure::fromCallable([new static,"capture"]))(true)); } } class ScopeChild239 extends Scope239 { public function capture($value) { echo "CHILD/",static::class,";"; return $value; } }
class ScopeMagic239 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { echo "HANDLER;"; return 9; } }
$owner = new ScopeMagic239; ScopeChild239::launch(); echo "AFTER;";

<?php
function shift239() { $GLOBALS["owner"] = null; echo "SHIFT;"; return false; }
class PacketBase239 { public $saved = 0; public function __construct($value) { $this->saved = $value; echo "CTOR;"; } public function capture($first,$ignored) { echo "CAPTURE;"; return $this; } public function __destruct() { echo "PACKET;"; } }
class PacketScope239 extends PacketBase239 { public static function launch() { global $owner; return $owner->MiSsInG((\Closure::fromCallable([new static(7),"capture"]))(true,shift239())); } } class PacketChild239 extends PacketScope239 {}
class Owner239 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { echo "HANDLER;"; return new class($arguments) { public function __construct(public array $saved) {} public function __destruct() { echo "CHILD;"; } }; } public function __destruct() { echo "OWNER;"; } }
$owner = new Owner239; $child = PacketChild239::launch(); echo "RETURN;"; echo ($child->saved[0] instanceof PacketChild239 && $child->saved[0]->saved === 7) ? "HELD;" : "BAD;"; unset($child); echo "AFTER;";

<?php
class StopBase239 { public function capture() { $GLOBALS["owner"] = null; echo "CAPTURE;"; throw new Exception("stop"); } public function __destruct() { echo "PACKET;"; } }
class StopScope239 extends StopBase239 { public static function launch() { global $owner; return $owner->MiSsInG((\Closure::fromCallable([new parent,"capture"]))(),later239()); } } class StopChild239 extends StopScope239 {}
function later239() { echo "LATER;"; return 1; } class FailedMagic239 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { echo "HANDLER;"; return 9; } public function __destruct() { echo "OWNER;"; } }
$owner = new FailedMagic239; $result = 0; try { $result = StopChild239::launch(); } catch (Exception $caught) { echo "CATCH;"; } echo $result === 0 ? "HELD;" : "BAD;";
